item.title: Drunk Bengaluru designer fires airgun from apartment balcony, residents run for cover
item.summary: In a shocking incident in Bengaluru, a man named Anurag Tiwari was taken into custody after firing an airgun from his balcony, which not only startled residents but also damaged a nearby vehicle. Tiwari claimed intoxication and personal turmoil led to this reckless behavior. Police have charged him under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and Arms Act, raising concerns about public safety.
